dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: Blood? ...Ah. If you hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have noticed.

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: To think that I'd forgotten to take care of that person's possessions...

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: ...Well, you can have it. That way, that person and I will have finally settled our grudge.

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: Right now, I need nothing more than a flask of muddy wine. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: Blink, and your life's gone... Drink, and it smooths the ride...

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't see a w— *hic* way out...

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: You... You trying to say I'm some sort of alcoholic? Hahaha— *hic* —ah. You're too kind.

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: I'm just a good-for-nothing swordsman... Good for nothing except prancing around waving my sword in yer pretty face. Hah! *hic*

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: Live by the sword, die by the sword. Kill or be killed. Which is it gonna be today? Only one way to find out! I'd rather take my chances with alcohol poisoning!

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: Come this evening, I'll have to get back to fighting to survive... *hic*

dialogues.speaker: Carpe Diem
dialogues.text: So tomorrow, there might not be much of me left to see. Hah! Hahaha...
